definitions.explanation: A decorative border or case used to hold and display paintings, photographs, certificates, or other flat items on a wall.

examples.english: I put the painting in a frame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{額縁|がくぶち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: The wooden frame suits the atmosphere of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}{証書|しょうしょ}→卒業証書：28982_sotsugyoushousho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{額縁|がくぶち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I framed my diploma and hung it on the wall.

notes:
USAGE:
{額縁|がくぶち} is the standard word for frames used to display artwork, photos, and certificates. It combines ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (framed picture/plaque) and {縁|ぶち} (border/rim). In architecture, {額縁|がくぶち}⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧ refers to a frame-like trim around windows or doors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {額縁|がくぶち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in a frame)
- {額縁|がくぶち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to display in a frame)
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{額縁|がくぶち} (wooden frame)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (photo frame — a related term for tabletop frames)
